verdict.rationale: Propose the 8:40 a.m. nonstop first. The $19 premium over the cheapest option is small for a nonstop that arrives at a normal afternoon hour. Across the history, Tessa repeatedly favors cleaner, more reliable routing and rejects connections when a suitably timed nonstop is close in price. The late-night nonstop is less aligned with her stated preference to avoid hotel arrivals after 11 when possible, even though the hotel can accommodate a late-arrival note. The two one-stop choices add connection risk without enough savings to outrank the morning nonstop.
